commit_message: Renderer: bind PBR material data for StandardLit
pr_title: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_body: Phase 2B renderer foundation. The GPU material contract now adds packed metallic/roughness and ambient-occlusion textures as linear-data bindings 7 and 8 while preserving existing bindings 0 through 6. Normal scale and occlusion strength travel through the material uniform, with white fallbacks preserving scalar factors and full ambient visibility when textures are absent.
